title: scabiosa leucantha var. minor
intro: Scabiosa leucantha var. minor, commonly known as dwarf pin-cushion flower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Caprifoliaceae family. It is a medicinal herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in Europe and Asia, for its various health benefits. Scabiosa leucantha var. minor is known to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
